packageRules.description: The Go implementation was removed; nothing is built from go.mod anymore.

JavaScript packages ship inside the plugin and the CLI. Each new version needs the publisher review in docs/dependencies.md and a regenerated plugin/vendor bundle, so updates wait for approval on the dependency dashboard and never automerge.
GoReleaser packages every release; review its version together with the Bun runtime pins in tools/prepare_bun.py.
